product_one_liner.value: Jack & Jill provides two AI recruiting agents that help job seekers find suitable roles and help companies discover and hire matching candidates.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists free and paid plans.

employee_band.notes: The company reports 28 people in London and San Francisco.

hq_location.notes: San Francisco is identified separately as its US-market office.

founded_year.notes: Both investors identify 2025, with Air Street specifying March 2025; the company's llms.txt inconsistently lists 2024.

eng_blog.notes: The index contains product announcements, hiring advice, company commentary and press, not two qualifying engineer-authored posts about building the product.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes getting started, core features, permissions and multiple integration guides.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed roles are Founding SF GTM, Founding Engineer, Founding Designer, Founding GTM Operator and Founding Operator; none has a qualifying AI/ML/data-science title.

model_provider.notes: A review documenting the Platform Terms on September 25, 2026 names these providers; the attribution relies on that captured review.

compliance_certs.notes: The reviewed legal pages make no explicit certification claims among the five requested. The privacy policy describes UK GDPR rights, rather than claiming certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The September 2026 Series A falls within the requested 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: An Account Executive (SF) posting is accessible with an application link.

launched_6mo.notes: Company Insights launched on November 4, 2026, adding company-growth, hiring and retention context to candidate histories.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Franky Athill's profile lists his CMO / Founding Team tenure ending in August 2026, within the window. The company careers page still lists him as CMO.

crm_stack_signal.notes: No CRM or sales/marketing system is named in the reviewed account-executive posting or documentation; ATS integrations are not counted as CRM systems.
